column1: # linkcheck.py's known list: references to an old path that stay on purpose (keep) or wait for a planned fix (todo).
# One rule per line, tab-separated: file glob, old path or folder (repo-relative), keep|todo, why. A rule matches only
# that old path (or what was under that folder), so it never hides a later move; linkcheck.py prints the todo rules on
# every run and lists rules that match nothing any more (remove those).
